Triage update — I reproduced the 502 in staging using Finlytics' curl script (thanks for the sample). Attached are the trimmed runtime logs showing a kernel selection exception before the reranker call: stack mentions "failed to allocate temp buffer" followed by an upstream 502 returned from the routing proxy. I ran it with batch_size 50 and sequence-length profile matching their payload.

What I tried:
- Reduced batch_size to 20: succeeds consistently.
- Increased client timeout to 30s: no change (confirms not client cutoff).
- Added X-Redwood-Debug: 1 and re-ran: new internal id: rw-req-20260718-9c3f; attached logs.

Attachments:
- redwood-runtime-logs-20260718.txt (trimmed kernel trace + routing proxy snippet)

Next steps:
- Neha: looks like a memory plateau under batch=50 for this model/quantization combo. Short-term mitigation: advise Finlytics to cap batch_size to 25 and add exponential retry with jitter at the reranker client.
- I'll open INF-5123 and attach logs (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5123).

Alice — could you run the same curl with X-Redwood-Debug: 1 so we can correlate your prod id to our staging traces? If you paste the x-request-id back (or the new rw-req id) we can match. ETA on a short patch is ~2 business days once we confirm the memory regression; we'll push a guard in the batching layer first.

Thanks,
Dylan
